verdict.rationale: Operating a cap-table SaaS through natural-language commands is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only conventional UI workflows: share issuance, vesting, round modeling, reports and spreadsheet import. Nothing shows an AI assistant, chat interface or natural-language command layer. The llms.txt file only describes the site to LLMs; it is an adjacent artifact and does not let a user operate the product in natural language.
